chunks: Said (the Lord): 'Your prayer is answered. Therefore persist and do not follow the path of those who are ignorant.'

key_terms.الَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ: Those who do not know/ignorant ones

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Your prayer is answered' in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a direct divine response to the supplication of Prophet Yunus (Jonah) or, in some narrations, to the collective plea of the believers, emphasizing the transition from supplication to steadfast action (istiqamah). It serves as a practical guide for the faithful, urging them to maintain moral rectitude and avoid the path of the ignorant (jahilun), which is characterized by blind following and lack of deep understanding. This highlights the Shia emphasis on combining sincere du'a with conscious adherence to the true path, distinguishing believers from those who merely follow tradition without knowledge.
